overview: For decades, microbiology could only see what it could grow — and it turns out that was only a small slice of what's actually there.

aspects.label: Overview / Core Definition
aspects.valueA: Characterizes a microbial community by growing organisms on selective/enriched media and identifying the isolates that grow.
aspects.valueB: Characterizes a microbial community directly from extracted nucleic acids (e.g. 16S sequencing, shotgun metagenomics), without requiring growth.

aspects.label: Detection of Unculturable Organisms
aspects.valueA: Misses the large fraction of microbial taxa that cannot be grown under standard laboratory conditions ('the great plate count anomaly').
aspects.valueB: Detects both culturable and unculturable organisms, since it doesn't depend on growth at all.

aspects.label: Live vs Dead Distinction
aspects.valueA: Only detects living, viable, culturable organisms by definition.
aspects.valueB: Can detect DNA from both live and dead cells unless paired with a viability-selective step (e.g. PMA treatment).

aspects.label: Phenotypic Information Available
aspects.valueA: Provides direct phenotypic data: antibiotic susceptibility, growth characteristics, biochemical profile.
aspects.valueB: Provides genotypic/sequence data only; phenotype must be inferred or confirmed separately.

aspects.label: Relative Abundance Accuracy
aspects.valueA: Skewed toward fast-growing, easily culturable organisms, misrepresenting the true community structure.
aspects.valueB: More representative of true relative abundance, though still subject to extraction and amplification biases.

aspects.label: Cost and Turnaround
aspects.valueA: Generally cheaper for a single known target but slow for full community profiling (days for growth).
aspects.valueB: Often faster for full community characterization once sequencing infrastructure is in place, though data analysis adds its own time.

aspects.label: Typical Use Case
aspects.valueA: Confirming a specific pathogen and getting an antibiogram for treatment decisions.
aspects.valueB: Comprehensive community-wide research studies, discovery of novel or fastidious organisms.

aspects.label: Key Distinguishing Feature
aspects.valueA: Only detects organisms that grow, but yields phenotypic data.
aspects.valueB: Detects the whole community regardless of culturability, but yields only genotypic data.
